A small fix on top of [1.0.0](https://github.com/coinman-dev/exchange-rates/releases/tag/v1.0.0).

## Fixed

- The logo in the About section and the app icon were drawn slightly off-centre: the artwork sat a little up and to the left inside the white circle. Both are now centred exactly as in the source artwork.

## Install

Download `exchange-rates-1.0.1.apk` below and open it on your phone (Android 8.0 or newer); allow installation from this source when asked. It installs over 1.0.0 or 0.1.0-beta and keeps your currencies and settings.
